product_one_liner.value: Gushwork is an AI growth platform for small and mid-sized businesses that helps them get discovered across Google and AI search and turn that attention into qualified leads.

pricing_page.notes: The public page lists pricing starting at $900/month.

eng_blog.notes: The readable index is a marketing/content blog; it does not show at least two engineer-authored posts about building the product.

public_docs.notes: The homepage navigation/footer does not expose a public docs, help-center, or developer-portal link.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: The open board lists Forward Deployed Engineer, Implementation Engineer, and Talent Acquisition Partner - GTM, but no qualifying AI/ML/data-science title.

model_provider.notes: The reviewed public product, blog, and privacy materials mention AI/search products and third-party AI surfaces but do not name the underlying model provider used by Gushwork.

compliance_certs.notes: The reviewed legal/privacy page names none of SOC 2, ISO 27001, HIPAA, GDPR, or PCI DSS as a claimed certification.
